data.source: same personal raw OpenVR vAccel,20train4val existingrecordings,58/16 frozen original windows
data.input: DCremoved separateXYZ log-magnitude spectra0-500Hz and56 multiscale energy features; no time-domain norm; STFT complex phase not retained
data.augmentation: training-only shared temporal roll with seam masks; no pitch/gain/axis-specific augmentation
data.audio_activity_labels: fixed TRAIN-only nonzero-frame energy GMM from20261017, not pYIN/human speech labels
data.normalization: sameparameters allrecords; futuremultiusercomparisons must freeze a shared pooledtrain calibration, never refit per targetuser
data.identity_scope: Singleperson: cannot measure identity discrimination. Selected502 descriptors retained exactly, not lossless original waveform preservation. ACC feature recovery is not identityaccuracy.
data.notes: Activity supervision and crossmodal temporalalignment do not require matching spectralstructures. Alignmentloss is trainingonly; no microphone used at inference. No absolute-time positionalembeddings.

joint_training.alignment: same-frame lowdimensional microphone descriptor InfoNCE, training only, does not equate ACC and audio spectra
joint_training.retention_probe: same train-only ridge10 frozen latent to ACC for every route
joint_training.representation: ungated exact raw502 plus latent mean/std128
